reason: The EVM-only RPC reports Backend.EvmBaseFee, the current base fee, for every block; it has no per-height base fee. Production EVM-only blocks execute at a constant zero base fee, so this shows only when the fixture's base fee changes between blocks.
Same as eth_getBlockByNumber result.baseFeePerGas: the current base fee is reported for every block.
A dynamic-fee transaction's gasPrice is its effective price, which the EVM-only RPC computes from the current base fee rather than its block's.
The EVM-only RPC reports a zero base fee for every block in fee history.
The EVM-only RPC's reward percentiles are of effective gas price, where v2's are of the priority fee; the two agree only at a zero base fee.
The EVM-only RPC does not aggregate receipt blooms into the block bloom and always reports zero.
size is the consensus block's encoded size, and a v2 block carries each transaction in a Cosmos envelope where an EVM-only block carries raw RLP.
The EVM-only RPC does not implement eth_getBlockReceipts.
The EVM-only RPC serves state only at the latest block.
The coinbase is v2's fee collector (keeper.GetCoinbaseAddress on every chain), which distribution empties every block; the EVM-only executor keeps go-ethereum's coinbase credit.
The EVM-only RPC does not implement eth_getStorageAt.
For an unknown hash v2 returns a 'block not found' error; the EVM-only RPC returns null, as go-ethereum does.
For a contract creation v2 omits to; the EVM-only RPC sets it to null, as go-ethereum does.
